note: Remote USFS campground where the Spotted Bear River meets the South Fork Flathead, 55 mi south of Hungry Horse on the gravel East Side Reservoir Rd #38; sites set back from the road in second-growth timber, most above the river. A footbridge by the Spotted Bear Ranger Station (1/4 mi) reaches a sandy beach on the South Fork. High use but often has open sites midweek; a base for huckleberry picking and fishing. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated April 10, 2025): confirmed $13 in season / free 9/30-5/15, 13 sites, 32-ft trailers, first-come, vault toilets, water in season; added $5 extra vehicle, 16-day stay limit, season and road-closure note. Season page says 'Seasons of Use 5/15 - 5/30', apparently a typo for the May 15 - Sept 30 maintained season, so no dates written. Alerts: NCDE food storage and wilderness orders only.
